-- FINAL ANSWER
SELECT 
    AVG("Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)") AS avg_free_meal_percentage,
    SUM(CASE WHEN "Charter School (Y/N)" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS charter_school_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN "Charter School (Y/N)" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_charter_school_count,
    AVG(AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite) / 3 AS avg_sat_score,
    CASE 
        WHEN "Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 600 THEN 'Very High'
        WHEN "Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 500 THEN 'High'
        ELSE 'Moderate'
    END AS free_meal_category,
    COUNT(*) AS school_count
FROM 
    frpm
JOIN 
    satscores ON frpm.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE 
    "County Name" = 'Los Angeles' 
    AND "Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 500 
    AND "FRPM Count (K-12)" < 700
GROUP BY 
    free_meal_category;

sql:
SELECT 
    'San Diego' AS County,
    COUNT(*) AS TotalVirtualSchools,
    SUM(CASE WHEN "Charter School (Y/N)" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CharterSchoolCount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN "Charter School (Y/N)" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS RegularSchoolCount,
    AVG(CAST("Enrollment (K-12)" AS DECIMAL(18, 6))) AS AverageEnrollment,
    AVG(CAST("Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)" AS DECIMAL(18, 6))) AS AverageFreeMealPercentage,
    AVG(CAST("Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS DECIMAL(18, 6))) AS AverageFRPMPercentage,
    MAX("Enrollment (K-12)") AS LargestEnrollment,
    (SELECT "School Name" FROM frpm JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode WHERE schools.Virtual = 'F' AND frpm."County Name" = 'San Diego' ORDER BY "Enrollment (K-12)" DESC LIMIT 1) AS LargestSchoolName
FROM 
    frpm
JOIN 
    schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE

SELECT 
    schools."School" AS "School Name",
    schools.Street || ', ' || schools.City || ', ' || schools.State || ' ' || schools.Zip AS "Unabbreviated Mailing Address",
    schools.Website,
    frpm."Enrollment (K-12)",
    frpm."FRPM Count (K-12)",
    frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)",
    satscores.NumTstTakr,
    satscores.NumGE1500,
    CASE 
        WHEN frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 70 AND (satscores.NumGE1500 * 100.0 / satscores.NumTstTakr) > 20 THEN 'High-performing despite high FRPM'
        WHEN frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" < 30 AND (satscores.NumGE1500 * 100.0 / satscores.NumTstTakr) < 10 THEN 'Low-performing despite low FRPM'
        ELSE 'Normal performance'
    END AS Performance
FROM 
    frpm
JOIN 
    schools ON frpm."School Code" = schools.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN 
    satscores ON frpm."School Code" = satscores.cds
WHERE 
    "Charter School (Y/N)" = 0
ORDER BY 
    "FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 1;

sql:
WITH filtered_schools AS (
    SELECT 
        frpm.CDSCode,
        "Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)",
        "Charter School (Y/N)",
        "Free Meal Count (K-12)"
    FROM 
        frpm
    WHERE 
        "County Name" = 'Los Angeles' 
        AND "Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 500 
        AND "FRPM Count (K-12)" < 700
),
sat_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        cds,
        (AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite) / 3.0 AS avg_sat_score
    FROM 
        satscores
),
categorized_schools AS (
    SELECT 
        "Free Meal Count (K-12)",
        CASE 
            WHEN "Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 600 THEN 'Very High'
            WHEN "Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 500 THEN 'High'
            ELSE 'Moderate'
        END AS free_meal_category
    FROM 
        filtered_schools
)

SELECT 
    AVG("Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)") AS avg_free_meal_percentage,
    SUM(CASE WHEN "Charter School (Y/N)" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS charter_school_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN "Charter School (Y/N)" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_charter_school_count,
    AVG(sat_scores.avg_sat_score) AS avg_sat_score,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN free_meal_category = 'High' THEN 1 END) AS high_category_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN free_meal_category = 'Very High' THEN 1 END) AS very_high_category_count
FROM 
    filtered_schools
JOIN 
    sat_scores ON filtered_schools.CDSCode = sat_scores.cds
JOIN 
    categorized_schools ON filtered_schools."Free Meal Count (K-12)" = categorized_schools."Free Meal Count (K-12)";

sql:
WITH school_enrollment AS (
    SELECT 
        "School Name", 
        "Enrollment (K-12)", 
        "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)"
    FROM frpm
    WHERE "Low Grade" = '9' AND "High Grade" = '12' AND "County Name" = 'Amador'
),
largest_school AS (
    SELECT "School Name", "Enrollment (K-12)"
    FROM school_enrollment
    ORDER BY "Enrollment (K-12)" DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
high_poverty_schools AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS High_Poverty_Schools
    FROM school_enrollment
    WHERE "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 0.75
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT "Enrollment (K-12)" FROM largest_school) AS Largest_Enrollment,
    (SELECT "School Name" FROM largest_school) AS Largest_School_Name,
    (SELECT High_Poverty_Schools FROM high_poverty_schools) AS High_Poverty_Schools;

WITH CustomerSpending AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Price) AS TotalSpending
    FROM transactions_1k
    GROUP BY CustomerID
),
MaxSpending AS (
    SELECT MAX(TotalSpending) AS MaxSpending
    FROM CustomerSpending
)

    t.CustomerID AS TopSpendingCustomerID,
    SUM(t.Price) / SUM(t.Amount) AS AveragePricePerItem,
    c.Currency
FROM 
    transactions_1k t
JOIN 
    customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
JOIN 
    CustomerSpending cs ON t.CustomerID = cs.CustomerID
JOIN 
    MaxSpending ms ON cs.TotalSpending = ms.MaxSpending
GROUP BY 
    t.CustomerID, c.Currency;

    AVG(CAST(DATE_DIFF('day', c.birth_date, a.date) AS DECIMAL(18, 6)) / 365.25) AS average_age_at_opening,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_number_with_loans,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN c.client_id END) AS number_with_successfully_completed_loans,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.status = 'D' THEN c.client_id END) AS number_currently_in_debt,
    MIN(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.date)) AS earliest_year,
    MAX(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.date)) AS latest_year
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id

sql:
WITH ChampionTimes AS (
    SELECT 
        r.year, 
        res.time,
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
        CASE 
            WHEN POSITION('.' IN SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2)) > 0 THEN 
                CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER)
            ELSE 0
        END AS time_in_seconds
    FROM races r
    JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    WHERE res.position = 1
    AND r.year < 1975
    AND res.time IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    year, 
    AVG(time_in_seconds) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM ChampionTimes
GROUP BY year;

WITH ChampionTimes AS (
    SELECT r.year, 
           res.time,
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 3) AS INTEGER) +
           CASE 
               WHEN POSITION('.' IN res.time) > 0 THEN 
                   CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, '.', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) / 1000
               ELSE 0
           END AS time_in_seconds
    FROM races r
    JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    WHERE res.position = 1
    AND r.year < 1975
    AND res.time IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT year, AVG(time_in_seconds) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM ChampionTimes
GROUP BY year;

WITH ConvertedTimes AS (
    SELECT
        raceId,
        driverId,
        lap,
        position,
        -- Split the time into minutes and seconds
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) AS minutes,
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) AS seconds,
        -- Check for the presence of milliseconds and handle accordingly
        CASE
            WHEN POSITION('.' IN SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2)) > 0 THEN
                CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER)
            ELSE
                0
        END AS milliseconds,
        -- Convert to total seconds
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 +

sql:
WITH RankedQualifying AS (
    SELECT qualifyId, driverId, position,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY position) AS rn
    FROM qualifying
    WHERE raceId = (
        SELECT raceId
        FROM races
        WHERE year = 2008 AND circuitId = (
            SELECT circuitId
            FROM circuits
            WHERE name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit'
        )
    )
)
SELECT forename, surname
FROM drivers
WHERE driverId = (
    SELECT driverId
    FROM RankedQualifying
    WHERE rn = 3 AND position = 1
);

WITH total_drivers AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT results.driverId) AS total_drivers
  FROM results
  JOIN races ON results.raceId = races.raceId
  WHERE YEAR(races.date) BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005
),
eligible_drivers AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT results.driverId) AS eligible_drivers
  FROM results
  JOIN races ON results.raceId = races.raceId
  JOIN drivers ON results.driverId = drivers.driverId
  WHERE YEAR(races.date) BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005
  AND YEAR(drivers.dob) < 1985
  AND laps > 50
)
SELECT 
  (eligible_drivers.eligible_drivers * 100.0 / total_drivers.total_drivers) AS percentage
FROM total_drivers, eligible_drivers;

WITH member_counts AS (
    SELECT z.state, COUNT(*) AS member_count
    FROM member m
    JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
    WHERE m.position = 'Member' AND z.state IN ('New Jersey', 'Vermont')
    GROUP BY z.state
),
total_members AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_member_count
    FROM member
    WHERE position = 'Member'
)

    (SELECT member_count FROM member_counts WHERE state = 'New Jersey') / total_member_count * 100.0 -
    (SELECT member_count FROM member_counts WHERE state = 'Vermont') / total_member_count * 100.0 AS percentage_difference
FROM total_members;

sql:
SELECT 
    b.bond_id,
    b.bond_type,
    c.atom_id AS atom1,
    a1.element AS element1,
    c.atom_id2 AS atom2,
    a2.element AS element2,
    CASE
        WHEN a1.element = 'Cl' OR a2.element = 'Cl' THEN 'Contains Chlorine'
        WHEN a1.element = 'C' AND a2.element = 'C' THEN 'Carbon-Carbon Bond'
        ELSE 'Other Bond Type'
    END AS bond_classification,
    m.label AS molecule_label
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE c.atom_id = 'TR000_2' OR c.atom_id2 = 'TR000_2';

FROM (
    SELECT element1 AS element FROM (
        SELECT c.bond_id, a1.element AS element1, a2.element AS element2
        FROM (
            SELECT c.bond_id, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
            FROM connected c
            JOIN (
                SELECT molecule_id, bond_id
                FROM bond
                WHERE bond_type = '#'
            ) b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
        ) c
        JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
        JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    )
    UNION
    SELECT element2 AS element FROM (
        SELECT c.bond_id, a1.element AS element1, a2.element AS element2
        FROM (
            SELECT c.bond_id, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
            FROM connected c
            JOIN (
                SELECT molecule_id, bond_id
                FROM bond
                WHERE bond_type = '#'
            ) b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
        ) c
        JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
        JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    )
) AS elements;

sql:
WITH bond_details AS (
    SELECT 
        b.bond_id,
        b.bond_type,
        a1.atom_id AS atom1_id,
        a1.element AS atom1_element,
        a2.atom_id AS atom2_id,
        a2.element AS atom2_element,
        CASE 
            WHEN a1.element = 'cl' OR a2.element = 'cl' THEN 'Contains Chlorine'
            WHEN a1.element = 'c' AND a2.element = 'c' THEN 'Carbon-Carbon Bond'
            ELSE 'Other Bond Type'
        END AS bond_classification
    FROM 
        bond b
    JOIN 
        connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    WHERE 
        b.bond_id IN ('TR000_2_4', 'TR000_1_2', 'TR000_2_3', 'TR000_2_5')
),
molecule_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) AS atom_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS bond_count
    FROM 
        molecule m
    JOIN 
        atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
    JOIN 
        bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        m.molecule_id = (SELECT DISTINCT a.molecule_id FROM atom a WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR000_2')
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id
)
SELECT 
    bd.bond_id,
    bd.bond_type,
    bd.atom1_id,
    bd.atom1_element,
    bd.atom2_id,
    bd.atom2_element,
    bd.bond_classification,
    mc.atom_count,
    mc.bond_count
FROM 
    bond_details bd
JOIN 
    molecule_counts mc ON bd.bond_id LIKE mc.molecule_id || '%';
